articles.title: How to predict the behavior of molecules from scant data
articles.title_en: How to predict the behavior of molecules from scant data
articles.summary: A machine-learning approach called CheMeleon provides a practical way to develop new drugs or other molecules with much less detailed, expensive experimentation.
articles.summary_en: A machine-learning approach called CheMeleon provides a practical way to develop new drugs or other molecules with much less detailed, expensive experimentation.
